gizwits_auth.title: Bestway V01 Login (Gizwits)
gizwits_auth.description: Enter your Bestway Smart Hub app credentials

aws_iot_auth.title: Bestway V02 Login (AWS IoT)
aws_iot_auth.description: Paste the code or link from the app's Share device screen (both the older RW_Share_ code and the newer smart-spa share link are accepted), OR enter an existing visitor_id. Provide ONE option only.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Bestway API
error.unknown_connection_error: Unexpected connector error - check logs for details
error.qr_or_visitor_required: Either provide an existing visitor_id OR scan a QR code. One option is required.
error.invalid_qr_format: Invalid QR code format. QR code must start with 'RW_Share_'.
error.invalid_format: Invalid QR code format. QR code must start with 'RW_Share_'.
error.binding_failed: QR code binding failed. The code may be expired or already used. Generate a fresh QR code from your spa.
error.no_devices_found: No devices found. Please check your spa is powered on and connected.
error.qr_code_required: Either provide an existing visitor_id OR scan a QR code. One option is required.
error.missing_share_id: No share id found in that link. Copy the full 'Share device' link (or the share id) from the Bestway Connect app.
error.invalid_share_id: That share code doesn't look valid. Copy the full 'Share device' link from the Bestway Connect app and try again.
error.share_already_used: This share is already linked to this account, or you scanned your own device's invitation. Generate a fresh share link and try again.
error.device_not_found: The shared device could not be found. Make sure the spa is powered on and the share link is fresh, then try again.
error.share_failed: Could not redeem the share link. It may have expired or already been used. Generate a fresh link from the Bestway Connect app.

data_description.bubbles_mode: Some Airjet V02 hot tubs only have on/off bubbles physically, even though the cloud accepts a 3-level value. Pick the option that matches your hardware. Changes apply after the integration reloads.
